system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, this is James Kim. I placed an order recently, but due to some changes in my life, I no longer need most of the items—specifically the hiking boots, watch, keyboard, charger, jacket, and running shoes. If it’s possible to cancel just those items, that would be great. If not, I’m okay with cancelling the whole order.

My email is james.kim1995@example.com. Sorry for the trouble, and thank you for your help.

Thanks — I can help with this. I tried to look you up by the email you gave, but ran into a technical issue. I still need to verify your identity before I can access your order(s).

Could you please confirm either:
- your zip code (so I can look up your user id from your name James Kim), or
- the order id (if you have it handy), or
- your user id (if you already know it)?

Also please confirm the items you want canceled: hiking boots, watch, keyboard, charger, jacket, and running shoes — is that correct?

One more quick note on options so you know what to expect:
- I’ll check the order status after I authenticate. If the order is still pending, I can try to cancel items or the whole order — if you want the whole order canceled, I’ll need a cancellation reason of either “no longer needed” or “ordered by mistake” before proceeding.
- If the order is already processed or delivered, we won’t be able to cancel; we’ll then look at return or exchange options instead.

Once you confirm your zip code (or order id/user id) and the items (and whether you prefer whole-order cancellation if partial isn’t possible), I’ll look up the order and report back with the exact options.

Thank you for explaining everything so clearly.

My zip code is 94109. And yes, the items I’d like to cancel are the hiking boots, watch, keyboard, charger, jacket, and running shoes.

If it’s not possible to cancel just those items, I’m okay with cancelling the whole order. The reason would be “no longer needed.”

Let me know if you need anything else from me. Thanks again.
